info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Owner Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Account Owner Retrieval API allows users to access ownership details for specific customer accounts using their unique identifiers. This API endpoint is key for financial institutions and service providers that need to verify account ownership or manage customer relationships. Developers can utilize this endpoint to enhance user experience by displaying accurate account owner information in various applications. Typical consumers include banking applications, customer support systems, and account management platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve the owner of a specific account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the owner of a specified account under a particular customer. The information returned includes the owner's name, contact information, and other relevant details pertaining to the account ownership.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the owner information of a specific account associated with a customer. This request will return details about the account owner, including any relevant identification and contact information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the owner information.

GetCustomerAccountOwnerRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the owner of account ACC-200045, belonging to customer CUST-100045.

ownerName.description: The name of the account owner.

ownerAddress.description: The address of the account owner.

asOfDate.description: The timestamp indicating the date the data was captured, in Unix epoch format.

metadata.description: Contains additional information related to the response.

GetCustomerAccountOwnerResponse_200.description: Schema representing the owner details for a specific account.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographical region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Schema containing metadata information related to the API response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is processing the request.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme using Bearer tokens, specifically in the form of JSON Web Tokens (JWT). This method allows secured access to resources by passing the token in the authorization header.
